notes.id: Langganan Tanukonomy Plus kini bisa dibeli lewat Google Play, bulanan atau tahunan, dengan pembayaran sungguhan.
notes.en: Tanukonomy Plus can now be bought through Google Play, monthly or yearly, with real payments.

notes.id: Pembelian Plus tetap aktif sesudah keluar akun dan bisa dipulihkan dari Akun di ponsel lain.
notes.en: Your Plus purchase stays active after you sign out and can be restored from Account on another phone.
